paragraphs: Euna Solutions sells a purpose-built, cloud-based set of financial software designed exclusively for the public sector. The buyers it names are cities, counties, states, school districts and publicly funded healthcare organizations of all sizes.

The budget product carries planning through publication, letting teams publish digital budget books and ACFRs to an interactive public portal. It is written to meet GFOA, GASB and accessibility standards. The grants product offers over 25,000 federal, state, municipal, local and foundation funding opportunities to search. On the spending side, the procurement product streamlines the purchase of goods and services with an emphasis on compliance. The company also offers integrations with ERPs including Workday, SAP, Carahsoft and Oracle.

The home page cites more than 3,600 organizations. For budgeting alone it cites 1,000+ organizations supported. Many staff are said to come from the public sector, with first-hand experience of government, education and nonprofits. A Euna Budget Enterprise option is aimed at larger governments and public agencies.

quote.text: Euna’s Financial Suite is a purpose-built, cloud-based set of solutions designed exclusively for the public sector.
